question: T has two sons namely N and L. S is the only child of his father. R and S are grandchildren of T. P is L's wife. M is the mother of S. How is N related to R?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a0334b9becb3302df465a62695face23306cb77a658488e237ca12074ac814e.png] 

Clearly, N is the uncle of R.

Hence, ‘**Uncle**’ is the correct answer.
